top_signals.title: Microsoft Patches a Record 570 Security Flaws
top_signals.summary: Microsoft Corp. today released software updates to plug at least 570 security holes in its Windows operating systems and other software, almost triple the number of vulnerabilities the software giant fixed in its record-smashing Patch Tuesday release last month. Microsoft attributed the burgeoning patch counts to vulnerability discoveries aided by artificial intelligence.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Europe's Key Rivers are Drying Up As Extreme Heat Impact Widens
top_signals.summary: Europe’s biggest rivers are drying up after a series of heat waves. That’s disrupting the transport of goods and curbing power generation across the continent, Rachel Graham explains (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: AbbVie Set to Sell $10 Billion in Bonds to Fund Apogee Deal
top_signals.summary: AbbVie Inc. has launched a $10 billion investment-grade bond sale to help fund its pending acquisition of fellow drugmaker Apogee Therapeutics Inc.

top_signals.title: Griffin’s NYC Office Tower Set to Land $3.3 Billion Construction Loan
top_signals.summary: The team working on Citadel’s new Manhattan skyscraper expects to secure a $3.3 billion construction loan for the project.

top_signals.title: BNY to offer institutional crypto staking through Galaxy partnership
top_signals.summary: The custody giant is expanding beyond safekeeping by adding staking services, allowing eligible institutional clients to earn yield on proof-of-stake assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
